title: The Clock of the Lower Danube
author: Ivo Brightwater
blurb: Noor Blackwood, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
